title: PR body describes the juice golden as showing the health meter, but the demo deliberately runs with it off
location: demos/juice.dem:6-9 (contradicted claim in spec/pr-body.md, 'Golden discipline' section)
evidence:
pr-body.md: "30000ms (the calm busy neighborhood: 4 routers basic/mid/high, 7 houses, 2 hosts, all three tiers + a 2-member bundle, two QoS presets, live era-3 traffic, the forecast + the health meter) and 65000ms (the surge moment: the crisis banner, the bottleneck outline, the health telegraph — sim-produced, deterministic)." vs demos/juice.dem: "# forecast counting down); 65000ms = the surge moment. The health meter is
# DELIBERATELY off: on this richer map the surge drains the meter to terminal
# before the capture, freezing the crisis out of the frame — the meter's". The demo contains no `health on` verb (opt-in per harness/demo.odin:488 "case \"health\":").
detail: Acceptance item 4 requires the PR body's golden/re-bless record to be accurate; this description misleads a reviewer auditing the juice frame's expected pixels (no health card, banner at y_base=10).
recommended_fix: Update the PR body's juice-golden description: drop "the health meter"/"the health telegraph" and state the meter is deliberately off in this demo.

title: Gate count stale at 9 after palcheck grew the suite to 10 (ci-local.sh header/usage text and the PR body's Verification section)
evidence: tools/ci-local.sh:4 "#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 9 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)"; :6 "#   tools/ci-local.sh --mac           # the same 9 gates natively on macOS" (same text in usage() at :28,:30) — while the GATES array now contains "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck" (10 entries). pr-body.md Verification: "`tools/ci-local.sh --mac` — 9/9 gates green" vs the same body's r2 section: "Re-verified: `tools/ci-local.sh --mac` 10/10 gates green (the suite grew a gate)".
detail: The PR body's verification section contradicts both the diff's shape and its own re-verification; the script's stale literals invite exactly the gate-count drift its own comment warns about.
recommended_fix: Bump the four '9 gates' literals to 10 (or drop the literal count) and refresh the PR body's Verification section to the 10-gate list.
